metadata.title: Opindx: Open Journal Factor, Network Factor and Article Network Score
metadata.description: Complete annual Opindx journal metrics for citation years 2022-2026 from the OpenAlex snapshot of 2026-09-23 and the Norwegian Register list of 2026-07-26. Version 2026-09-v5 adds separate five-year OJF5 datasets in CSV, XLSX and Parquet, with a data dictionary and all-cell format verification. All thirty previously published NF/ANS and two-year OJF2 annual files are preserved byte-for-byte. OJF2 and OJF5 use fixed approved Norwegian Register citing channels and include journal self-citations; NF/ANS use OpenAlex and Norwegian Register calculation universes. Includes raw/filtered scores, journal metadata, count components, release notes and checksums. All metrics follow a twelve-month maturity policy; 2025/2026 are provisional and 2026 is incomplete. Inputs are OpenAlex (CC0) and the Norwegian Register (NLOD 2.0), with documented identity corrections. No official journal-level metrics, commercial roster, membership flag, benchmark matches or empirical paper-comparison data are included.
